notes.title: Earth's Shadow Released Today!
notes.content:
Earth's Shadow releases today with a 10% discount.

Want to thank everyone to gave suggestions and comments during Early Access. 

Earth's Shadow started as a relatively small scope project, However... turned out much larger and better than I originally anticipated with...

[list]
[*] 3 different modes (Story, Survival and Rogue modes)
[*] 3 different endings
[*] No level cap allows players to continue playing forever, finding continuously better dynamic loot and ever increasing challenging enemies
[/list]


Had a blast developing and hope everyone enjoys it!

notes.title: PATCH to update 1.2

Feel free to set updates to only occur when starting game if there are too many updates.

- Added NEW item!!!! "Laser Cooler" Device - allows player to shoot longer before weapon overheats
